system.description:
You breathe out an enormous quantity of smoke from your mouth creating a field of heavy gas all around you.

For the duration, a 15-foot radius of smoke surrounds you, heavily obscuring you from creatures who cannot perceive through smoke. Creatures, other than you, that enter or start their turn within the field of smoke take 2d8 Fire damage, plus an additional 4 Fire damage for every 5 feet they willingly move within this radius, as the smoke and ash burns their skin and lungs.

Creatures who possess a breathing apparatus do not take damage from walking in this jutsu's area of effect.

Also, when you deal fire damage to creatures within this radius, increase the damage dealt by +2.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above C-Rank, increase the damage dealt by beginning or entering the field by 1d8. If this jutsu is cast at B-Rank or higher, you can perform this jutsu as a reaction, when you would take an attack of opportunity. If this jutsu is cast at A-Rank or higher, when you deal fire damage to a creatures within this jutsu’s radius, increase the damage dealt by +4, instead of +2.
